chats.answer:
The best solar-powered security camera depends on whether you want excellent video quality, reliable motion detection, no monthly subscription, or the lowest price.

For most homes, I'd start with eufy, Reolink, and Arlo. If you're looking for a solar panel to add to an existing security camera rather than a complete camera-and-panel kit, compatibility is the most important factor.

If you only need a solar panel

For an existing camera, choose a panel explicitly compatible with your exact model. Check the charging connector, voltage, weatherproofing and mounting cable length. A 3–6W panel is a useful starting point for many battery cameras, but the manufacturer's requirements take priority.
